label: B1
name: Scenario B1 - link n1-n2 failure, distance-vector routing
description: Same traffic as the baseline. Link n1-n2 on the primary path is taken down at t = 3.0 s and restored at t = 6.0 s. Nodes run NS2's distance-vector routing (rtProto DV), which reacts to link-state changes.
known_cause: Link n1-n2 was deliberately disabled with `$ns rtmodel-at 3.0 down $n1 $n2` and re-enabled at t = 6.0 s. This is the experimental condition.
